status: 20 rounds and local final checks passed; public CI pending.

baseline.judgment: Implementation-agent judgments, not independent human ratings, physical-device learning studies, or actual driving validation.

rounds.observation: Frozen help-dialog case failed: holdingW behind the native modal starts movement.
rounds.hypothesis: Ignoring app driving shortcuts while help is open preserves modal isolation.
rounds.change: Guard document shortcut handling when the help dialog is open; retain native Escape/focus behavior.
rounds.assessment: Dialog criterion1→4 after actual keyboard/modal regression and complete manual visit pass; unchanged physics35 must pass.

rounds.observation: Frozen range case failed: ArrowUp starts driving and prevents native slider adjustment.
rounds.hypothesis: Respect native keyboard behavior for every form control before handling driving keys.
rounds.change: Exclude input,select,textarea,summary and editable content from driving shortcuts; keep button and scene driving keys.
rounds.assessment: Native-key criterion2→4 after real range semantics and full manual visit pass.

rounds.observation: Frozen Escape case failed: moving simulation ignores Escape.
rounds.hypothesis: A dedicated stop shortcut cancels manual movement, replay and queued camera movement without changing native modal Escape.
rounds.change: Handle Escape before editing guards, route through the existing explicit stop/cancellation function, and label the shortcut.
rounds.assessment: Stop-key criterion0→4 after immediate stop and normal manual/model interactions pass. First selector also selected the baseline pagehide defect; keep that failed diagnostic and retest only the intended independent paths before lifecycle round4.

rounds.observation: Frozen pagehide case failed: a model keeps playing through page-cache entry; camera-only cleanup ignored model movement.
rounds.hypothesis: Page lifecycle entry must explicitly pause every simulation mode before closing camera resources.
rounds.change: Pause running/model/replay/queued movement onpagehide, close camera and return controls to an idle state without automatic restart.
rounds.assessment: Visibility/lifecycle remains partial until hidden-draw failure is fixed; page-cache model stop is now executed. Reapplied and repeated after isolating the round3 selector diagnostic; original assertions are unchanged.

rounds.observation: Frozen hidden-document case failed: fallback2D repaints on every animation frame despite page visibility pause.
rounds.hypothesis: Skip world advancement and drawing while hidden, keeping the timing origin current.
rounds.change: Return before simulation/render work when document.hidden; retain a single animation chain and avoid catch-up movement.
rounds.assessment: Visibility criterion2→4 after hidden-draw counter, page-cache pause and manual visit pass; no battery percentage claimed.

rounds.observation: New synthetic-video probe: stable calibration passes, but unstable hands returnfalse while runStatus claims calibration succeeded.
rounds.hypothesis: Calibration feedback must depend on the actual calibration result while movement stays paused.
rounds.change: Report success only when calibrate returns true; otherwise provide retry guidance without enabling driving.
rounds.assessment: Score stays51: calibration feedback corrected, while malformed/future tracking observations remain pending. Synthetic camera/video/landmarks only; no human-hand accuracy claim.

rounds.observation: New negative probes throw on sparse/object/null landmarks and invalid callbacks attempt to draw undefined points.
rounds.hypothesis: Validate the complete21-point shape and video dimensions before measuring or drawing.
rounds.change: Require two complete finite in-frame landmark arrays; reject malformed dimensions and clear the overlay for rejected input.
rounds.assessment: Score stays51 pending timestamp correction. Red-before unit counterexamples cover sparse and malformed input; valid synthetic steering remains operational.

rounds.observation: Two new unit counterexamples and a synthetic-browser future-timestamp case fail: future/reordered input can refresh calibrated movement.
rounds.hypothesis: Freshness must be finite, monotonic and based on capture time, not receipt time.
rounds.change: Reject future,negative,nonfinite,stale or reordered timestamps; invalidate freshness on rejected temporal input and preserve the captured timestamp on valid results.
rounds.assessment: Tracking criterion2→4 after negative shape/time probes and synthetic stop/recovery behavior pass. Recovery does not auto-start; actual-hand model accuracy remains unverified.

rounds.observation: New worker-stall browser probe times out: a missing response leaves camera/worker busy indefinitely with no retry feedback.
rounds.hypothesis: Bound each frame-response wait and fail back to deliberate manual/retry controls.
rounds.change: After2s without a frame response, stop owned camera/worker/frame work and show a retry message. Initialization retains its separate45s bound.
rounds.assessment: Score stays53 until remaining device-end/cancellation boundaries are handled. Stall probe is red before; cleanup and fresh retry must pass.

rounds.observation: New deferred-permission probe fails: cancel leaves cameraButton disabled; late completion can overwrite a newer pending request UI.
rounds.hypothesis: Cancellation and completion must be owned by a request generation in both controller and UI.
rounds.change: Centralize camera cancellation/reset, invalidate UI request tickets on mode/lifecycle cancellation, and ignore stale catch/finally callbacks.
rounds.assessment: Consent/error criterion3→4 after deferred cancel/retry/late-completion, denial, owned cleanup, and page-cache flow pass. No real permission dialog or physical-camera capture used.

rounds.observation: New ended-track browser probe fails: camera/video ending does not close tracking or restore manual controls.
rounds.hypothesis: An ended video track must terminate its owning session and pause movement.
rounds.change: Own generation-guarded video-track ended listeners, close the session with feedback, and remove listeners during stop.
rounds.assessment: Media-lifecycle criterion2→3 after ended-track, stalled-worker and deliberate cleanup paths execute; late old-frame rejection remains pending.

rounds.observation: New delayed-capture probe fails: rejection from an old session pauses a newly calibrated/running camera session; old worker errors are also unowned.
rounds.hypothesis: Every asynchronous callback may mutate only its owning camera generation.
rounds.change: Guard initialization/runtime worker callbacks and bitmap rejection against obsolete generations; retain existing stale-success bitmap close.
rounds.assessment: Media-lifecycle criterion3→4 after stale rejection/worker callbacks, cancellation, device-end and owned cleanup pass. No claim of actual-hand accuracy.

rounds.observation: Frozen runtime graphics-loss test fails while initial2D fallback exists; no owned scene/observer teardown is exposed.
rounds.hypothesis: A stable scene adapter can dispose the lost3D view and preserve a usable2D simulation.
rounds.change: Own scene/material/texture/target/observer cleanup, preserve engine-shared Sprite geometry, pause motion/camera, and switch controls/labels to2D on native context loss.
rounds.assessment: Graphics criterion2→4 after simulated and nativeGLloss, resize/manual recovery, local visit and hidden fallback pass. No RAM/VRAM quantity claim.

rounds.observation: New cadence probes fail:10Hz movement covers one-third of60Hz displacement, and a model misses its declared duration.
rounds.hypothesis: Advance physics in bounded fixed substeps for elapsed active time, drawing once per browser frame.
rounds.change: Use up to200ms active elapsed time per frame, split into≤1/60s steps; hidden time remains excluded.
rounds.assessment: Model criterion3→4 after matching10Hz/60Hz paths and declared-time target completion, plus existing scenario/rewind checks. This is virtual-model timing, not real-car dynamics.

rounds.observation: A real-app VM boundary probe records4001 frames despite the intended3200 bound; record() itself is unbounded.
rounds.hypothesis: Bound recording at its single append boundary, preserving recent order and valid cursor/renderer invalidation.
rounds.change: Keep at most3200 recent frames, increment a history revision for rendering, and let normal trip/boundary limits control movement independently of rolling-history capacity.
rounds.assessment: Performance criterion2→3 after actual record4000 boundary/cursor/replay probe and existing full scenario tests; dynamic GPU-buffer allocation remains pending. First candidate passed all boundary assertions but the seeded test fixture had not refreshed UI before clicking replay. Seeder now calls the real renderUI; unchanged assertions rerun against baseline(4001frames fails) and candidate.

rounds.observation: Native allocation probe created166 graphics buffers during a short move; stationary2D repainted17times in180ms. Position buffers were already reused, but computeLineDistances replaced attributes every render.
rounds.hypothesis: Reuse bounded distance buffers and draw stationary2D only when its visible state changes.
rounds.change: Allocate dynamic position/distance buffers once, update only active ranges, compute distances within drawn points, and cache2D state/size signatures without resizing unchanged backings.
rounds.assessment: Performance criterion3→4 after native buffer-allocation bound, idle paint counter, change-triggered repaint and recovery paths pass. No physical-device power or memory amount claim.

rounds.observation: Frozen target-size case fails on primary controls; mobile fixed-height layout shrinks essential buttons and reading text.
rounds.hypothesis: Reachable44px controls and vertically scrollable compact layouts preserve practice without clipping learning/camera flows.
rounds.change: Increase primary targets, provide a compact responsive header/control deck, and let mobile learning/camera content scroll with readable text.
rounds.assessment: Touch criterion1→4 only after desktop/mobile size, reachability, real gesture and screenshot review. This selected desktop round is followed by explicit mobile validation.

rounds.observation: Owned HTTP probes fail: no local-only content policy/nosniff, and diagnostic/directory routes are exposed. Vendor notice says SDK metrics may occur. First integrated candidate passes actualWASM but exposes a preexisting transient unsteady status: next frame overwrites the warning. Corrected sustained calibration-readiness classification; no assertions/timeouts relaxed.
rounds.hypothesis: A local content policy and explicit public serving boundaries can preserve real model operation without external successful transfers.
rounds.change: Restrict connect/script/worker/media origins, retainWASM evaluation and correct MIME, disable directory/diagnostic serving, and verify actual local blank-frame inference. Keep unsteady readiness feedback until the sample window is actually steady.
rounds.assessment: Server2→4 andlocal-dependency3→4 if actualHTTP plus realWASM/model execution pass under policy. Blank frame verifies runtime only, not human-hand accuracy.

rounds.observation: No executable asset-integrity or fresh-install check exists. Upstream tarballSHA512/file bytes and official model download were independently compared successfully.
rounds.hypothesis: A checked asset manifest and clean tracked-source install make the public runtime reproducible and detect corruption.
rounds.change: Add byte/hash manifests, actual corruption detection, pinned Node/tooling metadata, and a clean install/assets/unit-process verifier with owned scratch cleanup.
rounds.assessment: Install2→4 after current and clean-source checks pass; upstream authenticity links/hashes retained, no user/private artifacts copied.

rounds.observation: Public source lacks a complete guide, own license, attribution/CI and final cross-engine/real-time route evidence. All3 real-time parking routes and Chromium/touch UI pass; WebKit fails focus restoration after help closes. Added explicit return-to-invoker focus.
rounds.hypothesis: An executable public release with honest documentation and final independent browser scenarios makes the work reviewable and reusable.
rounds.change: Document actual behavior/limits, license and attribute assets, format authored code, configure pinned CI, and execute full desktop/mobile plus Chromium/touch/WebKit and all three real-time model routes.
rounds.assessment: Publication0→4 andE2E1→4 after local final checks pass; remote CI must pass after publication. Scores are implementation-agent judgments, not human learning or driving validation. Recheck all3 UI engines after focus-only correction; retain passing3 real-time route executions from attempt1. Full6case suite remains mandatory in publicCI.

limitations: Implementation-agent rubric judgments. Synthetic video/landmarks and real blank-frame inference; no human-hand, real-phone learning or real-car validation.

realTimeRoutes.evidence: Round20 attempt1; focus-only correction followed, all3UIengines retested. Full6-case suite remains in CI.
